user.title: Create a light compositor
user.description: Use ONE individually addressed light, not a group, Lightener, segment alias or another mask. Setup starts in shadow mode and changes no hardware. Existing automations must be retargeted. Fallbacks are used only when the output has no stored attributes; RGB-only outputs default to white.

base.title: Base light
base.description: Replacing the base preserves virtual entity IDs and stored intents but switches Apply OFF. The previous light is left as-is. Review the new target before enabling Apply; Resume may be needed to authorize On. Replacement must support stored colors and configured channels.

add_mask.title: Add mask
add_mask.description: Higher priority wins each selected channel. On activates the mask; Off releases it. Power control contributes On while active. Leave power unchecked for notifications. Color includes RGB and color temperature supported by the base.

mask.title: Edit mask
mask.description: Saving preserves current activation, values and deadline. Changed channels and priority apply immediately. Duration changes apply on the next On. Legacy force-off masks retain their behavior unless you explicitly change it.

external_change.title: Light Masks paused after an external change
external_change.description: The output {output} changed while masks were active. Intent is preserved and output writes are paused. Stop competing physical/group writers, inspect Light Masks Explain, and press Resume when ready. Resume can turn the light on.

storage.title: Light Masks could not save intent
storage.description: A storage operation for {output} failed. Output writes are blocked. Check disk space, permissions and the Home Assistant log. After fixing storage, press Resume or reload. A rejected command must be submitted again.

delivery.title: Light Masks output did not converge
delivery.description: {output} did not reach the requested state after three attempts. Check connectivity, device capabilities and the log. No further attempts are made for this unchanged result until Sync, Resume or a new effective command.

endpoint.title: Light Masks output is no longer safe to control
endpoint.description: {output} has a native effect, unsupported capabilities, a conflicting owner, or aggregate membership. Stop the effect or remove the conflicting controller and inspect the configuration before Resume. Reload after a capability change.

explain.name: Explain
explain.description: Return stored intents, desired and observed state, and channel ownership.

resume.name: Resume
resume.description: Clear suspension and authorize the current intent, including On. Apply must also be enabled.

sync.name: Sync
sync.description: Retry the current result without clearing suspension or startup power protection.

clear_fields.name: Clear mask fields
clear_fields.description: Unset selected stored contributions without releasing mask activation.
